desc:
⚒️ You wake up in the King's mint – and you stay until your debt is paid.

Turn raw metal into shiny coins and keep the King's guard happy!

🪓 Chop wood and fire up the furnace
🔥 Melt copper, silver and gold bars
🔨 Forge sheets on the anvil and cool them in water
🪙 Cut and stamp coins with the King's seal
📜 Pin orders to the board and deliver them at the guard's window

💰 Spend your coins on new tools: Coin Punch, Axe & Tongs, Forge Hammer, Anvil and more
📖 Collect rare coins with special abilities in your collection book
👑 Earn Royal Seals for upgrades, classes and achievements in the lobby

👥 Play solo or bring up to 3 friends – pick a cell together in the lobby and work as a team!

🎮 Play on PC, mobile and console.

Will you ever buy your freedom? 🗝️
